attr.title: Commander Keen 4 Revamped
attr.desc: Commander Keen 4: Secret of the Oracle, rebuilt in C++ from the original game: smooth scrolling, upscaled art, remastered audio, two-player co-op and gamepad support.
attr.inst: Copy KEEN4E.EXE (v1.4 EGA) and the .CK4 files from your copy of the game, for example the Steam release (base4 folder), into ports/keen4revamped/gamedata.
